messages.subject: error when changing app setting from dashboard
parts:
I have an app that is running, and i wish to change the settings so that it will time out after 5 minutes of user inactivity, rather than the default of 15.  When I make the change from the dashboard I eventually get:

```
Waiting for task: 52449972
  deploying: Starting instances
  rollforward: Activating new instances
  terminating: Stopping old instances
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 52449981 error: Unhandled Exception: HTTP 599: Timeout
```

App is homer.shinyapps.io/sim_tutorial_Rmd.
